data.summary: Total IT experience of 7 years, including 2.7 years of hands-on experience in Anaplan Design, build, and maintain Anaplan models for business functions such as Sales Planning, FP&A, Supply Chain, and HR. Create modules, line items, lists, hierarchies, and dimensions according to business requirements. Implement complex formulas, allocations, and calculations to meet business logic needs. Optimize model performance by reducing sparsity, improving calculation speed, and managing time hierarchies. Manage data imports, exports, and data hubs for consistent master data. Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure accuracy. Build interactive dashboards (Anaplan UX) for management and stakeholders. Applied ALM for version control, module synchronization, and deployment from Dev → Test → Production. Follow DISCO methodology (Design, Implement, Support, Control, Optimize). Implement enhancements to models, dashboards, and calculations as per evolving business needs. Developed and integrated custom actions using PowerShell, PSADT, VBScript, Wise Script, and Batch scripting to support complex installation logic. Implemented major, minor, and small updates/upgrades, including rollback, self-healing, and self- repair mechanisms. Performed comprehensive MSI validation and quality assurance using AdminStudio and Wise Package Studio to ensure reliability and standardization. Created and deployed silent installation and uninstallation packages using command-line parameters and scripting best practices.
